page.layout: One column of lexicon entries, with Hebrew and Latin mixed, in one block under the running head. The page number is at top left and the running head at top right.

main_text.p: בֵּז m. בָּזָה f. Præda, Direptio.
בָּזַר Sparsit, Disperfit, Dissipavit. Pihel בִּזֵּר idem.
בָּחַל Fastidivit, Fastidium habuit, Aspernatus, Adversatus est.
בָּחַן Probavit, Exploravit. Niphal נִבְחַן Probatus fuit.
בָּחוֹן m. Specula, Turris: alterius forma, בְּחוֹנָיו Speculas ejus, Jesa.23.13.
בָּחַר Elegit, Delegit, Selegit. Niphal נִבְחַר Electus fuit. Pyhal Futur. יִבָּחֵר Eligetur, Eccles.9.4. quod Masorethæ legendum docent יִחְבַּר Confociatur.
בָּחוּר בָּחִיר m. Lectus, Selectus: Juvenis: Plur. בְּחוּרִים juvenes.
בָּטָא Pronunciavit, Effutivit. Pihel בִּטֵּא idem.
בָּטַח Fidit, Confidit. Hiphil הִבְטִיחַ Confidere fecit.
בִּטָּחוֹן בָּטַח m. בִּטְחָה בִּטְחָה f. Fiducia, Con-fidentia,

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some letters in the lexicon entries are small and blurred; forms such as בָּטַח and the final entry are copied as far as legible. The entry "Con-fidentia," runs on to the next page. No catchword or signature is printed. The Latin "uventus", "Selectissimu" and "Confociatur" are as printed and may be misprints.
